newsitem.title: USA: IMF welcomes Mexico's early loan repayment.
newsitem.headline: IMF welcomes Mexico's early loan repayment.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund Wednesday said it welcomed the decision of Mexico to make an advance repayment of $1.5 billion to the international institution and to repay the remaining $3.5 billion owed to the United States.

In a statement, IMF Managing Director Michel Camdessus said that the Mexican economy was expanding at a good pace with inflation and interest rates declining, export volume up strongly and imports recovered.
In addition, he said the current account deficit is now small and there was a strong increase in net international reserves last year.

"I welcome these positive developments, which have been reflected in Mexico's improved standing in international capital markets, and in the country's ability to restructure its external obligations on better terms that include longer maturities," he said.
He said that the country's commitment to reforms while maintaining a strong fiscal position and sound credit policy "provides a solid foundation for continuing support by the IMF to Mexico."
